theorems.statement: For canonical full Krom base Gamma_K and affine R, CSP(Gamma_K union {R}) is tractable iff R is bijunctive, equivalently affine+bijunctive = 2-affine = pinnings/equalities/disequalities.
A nonempty Boolean relation is affine and Horn iff it is definable by unary pinnings and equalities.
theorems.recognition: For Mx=b with solution x0 and rowspace W, W must be spanned by weight-1 rows plus weight-2 rows w with w dot x0 = 0.

theorems.statement: For canonical full Horn base Gamma_H and affine R, CSP(Gamma_H union {R}) is tractable iff R is Horn, hence iff R is pinnings+equalities.
For canonical full Horn base Gamma_H and bijunctive R, adding R remains tractable iff R itself is Horn.

knowledge_compilation_controls.fact: Over Boolean languages, polynomial compilation for every instance into DNNF occurs exactly for bijunctive-affine languages; otherwise some instance family requires exponential DNNF.
Even formulas with tiny final structured-DNNF can force exponential intermediate structured-DNNFs in every bottom-up compilation.

strategic_conclusion: Further universal progress cannot come merely from enlarging fixed pairwise Boolean carrier unions. It must use instance-specific global compatibility certificates.
